```{r}
umap_tsne_plots <- lapply(all_selections, function(df) {
  
  # determine if df holds group and condition selections or only condition selections
  if ("tMAV" %in% colnames(df)) {
    # df contains group and condition selections
    selections <- selections_clu_con
  } else {
    # df contains only condition selections
    selections <- selections_con
  }
  
  sce_iter <- sce
  
  # create UMAP plots
  plots <- c()
  for (selection in selections) {
    
    # set seed
    set.seed(42)
    
    # dimensionality reduction
    sce_iter <- runPCA(sce_iter, subset_row=df[[selection]])
    sce_iter <- runUMAP(sce_iter, dimred="PCA")
    sce_iter <- runTSNE(sce_iter, dimred="PCA")
    
    # create UMAP plot colored by condition
    plot1 <- ggplot(
      data = as.data.frame(reducedDim(sce_iter, "UMAP")),
      mapping = aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2, colour = sce_iter$group_id)
    ) +
      geom_point(size = 1, alpha = 0.7) +
      scale_colour_manual(values = cbf_palette[1:2]) +
      labs(title = "",
           x = "UMAP1",
           y = "UMAP2",
           colour = "Treatment") +
      theme_classic() +
      theme(
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none",
        text = element_text(size = 16),
        plot.title = element_text(
            hjust = 0.5,
            size = 18,
            face = "bold"
          )
      )
    
    # create UMAP plot colored by cell type
    plot2 <- ggplot(
      data = as.data.frame(reducedDim(sce_iter, "UMAP")),
      mapping = aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2, colour = sce_iter$cluster_id)
    ) +
      geom_point(size = 1, alpha = 0.7) +
      scale_colour_manual(values = cbf_palette[3:10]) +
      labs(title = selection,
           x = "",
           y = "UMAP2",
           colour = "Cell Type") +
      theme_classic() +
      theme(
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none",
        text = element_text(size = 16),
        plot.title = element_text(
            hjust = 0.5,
            size = 20,
            face = "bold"
          )
      )
    
    # create TSNE plot colored by condition
    plot3 <- ggplot(
      data = as.data.frame(reducedDim(sce_iter, "TSNE")),
      mapping = aes(x = TSNE1, y = TSNE2, colour = sce_iter$group_id)
    ) +
      geom_point(size = 1, alpha = 0.7) +
      scale_colour_manual(values = cbf_palette[1:2]) +
      labs(title = "",
           x = "TSNE1",
           y = "TSNE2",
           colour = "Treatment") +
      theme_classic() +
      theme(
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none",
        text = element_text(size = 16),
        plot.title = element_text(
            hjust = 0.5,
            size = 20,
            face = "bold"
          )
      )
    
    # create TSNE plot colored by cell type
    plot4 <- ggplot(
      data = as.data.frame(reducedDim(sce_iter, "TSNE")),
      mapping = aes(x = TSNE1, y = TSNE2, colour = sce_iter$cluster_id)
    ) +
      geom_point(size = 1, alpha = 0.7) +
      scale_colour_manual(values = cbf_palette[3:10]) +
      labs(title = selection,
           x = "",
           y = "TSNE2",
           colour = "Cell Type") +
      theme_classic() +
      theme(
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none",
        text = element_text(size = 16),
        plot.title = element_text(
            hjust = 0.5,
            size = 20,
            face = "bold"
          )
      )
    
    plots <- c(
      plots,
      plot1,
      plot2,
      plot3,
      plot4
    )
    
  }
  
  return(plots)
  
})
```

## ARI

```{r}
# define selections to be used for clustering
selections_clu_con <- c(
  "all_genes",
  "random",
  "HVG",
  "tF_sPVE",
  "tF_sPBDS",
  "tPVE_sPVE",
  "sPVE_tF",
  "sPBDS_tF",
  "sPVE_tPVE",
  "tMAV_sMAV",
  "tEN_sEN",
  "tMAD_sAD",
  "sMAV_tMAV",
  "sEN_tEN",
  "sAD_tMAD"
)

selections_con <- c(
  "all_genes",
  "random",
  "HVG",
  "tF_sPVE",
  "tF_sPBDS",
  "tPVE_sPVE",
  "sPVE_tF",
  "sPBDS_tF",
  "sPVE_tPVE",
  "common_sMAV",
  "common_sEN",
  "common_sAD",
  "sMAV_common",
  "sEN_common",
  "sAD_common"
)

all_sels <- unique(c(selections_clu_con, selections_con))
color_map <- setNames(qualitative_hcl(21, palette = "Dark 3"), all_sels)
```

```{r}
ari_scores <- lapply(all_selections, function(df) {
  
  # determine if df holds group and condition selections or only condition selections
  if ("tMAV" %in% colnames(df)) {
    # df contains group and condition selections
    selections <- selections_clu_con
  } else {
    # df contains only condition selections
    selections <- selections_con
  }
  
  sce_iter <- sce
  
  # calculate ARI scores
  ari_scores <- c()
  for (selection in selections) {
    
    # set seed
    set.seed(42)
    
    # dimensionality reduction and clustering
    sce_iter <- runPCA(sce_iter, subset_row=df[[selection]])
    g <- buildSNNGraph(sce_iter, use.dimred="PCA", type="jaccard")
    k <- cluster_louvain(g, resolution=0.3)$membership
    n_clusters <- length(unique(k))
    message(selection, ": ", n_clusters, " clusters")
    new_col <- paste0("cluster_re_", selection)
    sce_iter[[new_col]] <- factor(k, seq_along(unique(k)))
    
    # ARI score calculation
    ari_scores <- c(
      ari_scores,
      ARI(sce_iter$cluster_id, sce_iter[[new_col]])
    )
    
  }
  
  results <- data.frame(Selection = selections, ARI = ari_scores)
  results$Selection <- factor(results$Selection, levels = results$Selection)
  
  return(results)
  
})
```

```{r}

  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Selection, ARI), y = ARI, fill = Selection)) +
    geom_col() +

    theme(legend.position = "none") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_map) +
    labs(x = "", y = "ARI", title = "Cell Types & Conditions")
```

```{r}

)

selections_con <- c(
  "all_genes",

  "tPVE_sPVE",
  "sPVE_tF",

)

all_sels <- unique(c(selections_clu_con, selections_con))
color_map <- setNames(qualitative_hcl(21, palette = "Dark 3"), all_sels)
```

```{r}
lisi_scores <- lapply(all_selections, function(df) {
  
  # determine if df holds group and condition selections or only condition selections
  if ("tMAV" %in% colnames(df)) {
    # df contains group and condition selections
    selections <- selections_clu_con
  } else {
    # df contains only condition selections
    selections <- selections_con
  }
  
  sce_iter <- sce
  
  # calculate LISI scores
  lisi_scores <- list()
  for (selection in selections) {
    
    # set seed
    set.seed(42)
    
    # dimensionality reduction and data extraction
    sce_iter <- runPCA(sce_iter, subset_row=df[[selection]])
    y <- reducedDim(sce_iter, "PCA")
    cd <- colData(sce_iter)
    by <- c(
      LISI_cn="group_id",
      LISI_ct="cluster_id"
    )
    
    # LISI score calculation
    res <- sapply(by, \(.) {
        res <- compute_lisi(y, cd, .)
        n <- length(unique(cd[[.]]))
        (mean(res[[1]])-1)/(n-1)
    })
    
    lisi_scores[[selection]] <- data.frame(
      Selection = selection,
      LISI_ct = unname(res["LISI_ct"]),
      LISI_cn = unname(res["LISI_cn"])
    )
    
  }
  
  results <- do.call(rbind, lisi_scores)
  results$Selection <- factor(results$Selection, levels = results$Selection)
  return(results)
  
})
```

```{r}
lisi_scores_strat <- lapply(all_selections, function(df) {
  
  # determine if df holds group and condition selections or only condition selections
  if ("tMAV" %in% colnames(df)) {
    # df contains group and condition selections
    selections <- selections_clu_con
  } else {
    # df contains only condition selections
    selections <- selections_con
  }
  
  sce_iter <- sce
  
  # get unique cell types
  cell_types <- unique(colData(sce_iter)$cluster_id)
  
  # calculate LISI scores stratified by cell type
  lisi_scores <- list()
  
  for (cell_type in cell_types) {
    
    # subset to current cell type
    sce_subset <- sce_iter[, colData(sce_iter)$cluster_id == cell_type]
    
    for (selection in selections) {
      
      # set seed
      set.seed(42)
      
      # dimensionality reduction and data extraction
      sce_subset <- runPCA(sce_subset, subset_row=df[[selection]])
      y <- reducedDim(sce_subset, "PCA")
      cd <- colData(sce_subset)
      
      # define LISI variables (only group_id since we're stratified by cluster)
      by <- c(
        LISI_cn = "group_id"
      )
      
      # LISI score calculation
      res <- sapply(by, \(.) {
        res <- compute_lisi(y, cd, .)
        n <- length(unique(cd[[.]]))
        # handle case where only one level exists in subset
        if (n <= 1) {
          return(NA)
        }
        (mean(res[[1]]) - 1) / (n - 1)
      })
      
      # create unique key for cell_type + selection
      key <- paste0(cell_type, "_", selection)
      
      lisi_scores[[key]] <- data.frame(
        CellType = cell_type,
        Selection = selection,
        LISI_cn = unname(res["LISI_cn"])
      )
      
    }
  }
  
  results <- do.call(rbind, lisi_scores)
  results$Selection <- factor(results$Selection, levels = unique(selections))
  results$CellType <- factor(results$CellType, levels = sort(unique(cell_types)))
  
  return(results)
  
})
```

```{r}
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Selection, LISI_cn), y = LISI_cn, fill = Selection)) +
    geom_col() +
    coord_flip() +
    facet_wrap(~ CellType, scales = "free_y") + 
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      text = element_text(size = 16)
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_map) +
    labs(x = "", y = "LISI_cn", title = "Cell Types & Conditions")

ggsave("da_lisi_strat_clu_con.png", p1, path = "../../outs/kang/",
       width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
f <- function(x, id) {
  # regress PCs on 'id's
  y <- reducedDim(x, "PCA")
  ve <- attr(y, "varExplained")
  fit <- summary(lm(y~x[[id]]))
  # sum across coefficients of determination weighted
  # by variance explained & scale by total variance
  r2 <- vapply(fit, \(.) .$adj.r.squared, numeric(1))
  r2 <- r2[i <- r2 > 0]; ve <- ve[i]
  sum(ve*r2)/sum(ve)
}

pcr_scores <- lapply(all_selections, function(df) {
  
  # determine if df holds group and condition selections or only condition selections
  if ("tMAV" %in% colnames(df)) {
    # df contains group and condition selections
    selections <- selections_clu_con
  } else {
    # df contains only condition selections
    selections <- selections_con
  }
  
  sce_iter <- sce
  
  # calculate PCR scores
  pcr_scores <- list()
  for (selection in selections) {
    
    # set seed
    set.seed(42)
    
    # dimensionality reduction and data extraction
    sce_iter <- runPCA(sce_iter, subset_row=df[[selection]])
    ids <- c(
      PCR_ct="cluster_id",
      PCR_cn="group_id"
    )
    
    # PCR score calculation
    res <- sapply(names(ids), \(sta) f(sce_iter, ids[sta]))
    
    pcr_scores[[selection]] <- data.frame(
      Selection = selection,
      PCR_ct = unname(res["PCR_ct"]),
      PCR_cn = unname(res["PCR_cn"])
    )
    
  }
  
  results <- do.call(rbind, pcr_scores)
  results$Selection <- factor(results$Selection, levels = results$Selection)
  return(results)
  
})
```

```{r}
pcr_scores_strat <- lapply(all_selections, function(df) {
  
  # determine if df holds group and condition selections or only condition selections
  if ("tMAV" %in% colnames(df)) {
    # df contains group and condition selections
    selections <- selections_clu_con
  } else {
    # df contains only condition selections
    selections <- selections_con
  }
  
  sce_iter <- sce
  
  # get unique cell types
  cell_types <- unique(colData(sce_iter)$cluster_id)
  
  # calculate PCR scores stratified by cell type
  pcr_scores <- list()
  
  for (cell_type in cell_types) {
    
    # subset to current cell type
    sce_subset <- sce_iter[, colData(sce_iter)$cluster_id == cell_type]
    
    for (selection in selections) {
      
      # set seed
      set.seed(42)
      
      # dimensionality reduction and data extraction
      sce_subset <- runPCA(sce_subset, subset_row=df[[selection]])
      
      # define PCR variables (only group_id since we're stratified by cluster)
      ids <- c(
        PCR_cn = "group_id"
      )
      
      # PCR score calculation
      res <- sapply(names(ids), \(sta) {
        # handle case where only one level exists in subset
        if (length(unique(colData(sce_subset)[[ids[sta]]])) <= 1) {
          return(NA)
        }
        f(sce_subset, ids[sta])
      })
      
      # create unique key for cell_type + selection
      key <- paste0(cell_type, "_", selection)
      
      pcr_scores[[key]] <- data.frame(
        CellType = cell_type,
        Selection = selection,
        PCR_cn = unname(res["PCR_cn"])
      )
      
    }
  }
  
  results <- do.call(rbind, pcr_scores)
  results$Selection <- factor(results$Selection, levels = unique(selections))
  results$CellType <- factor(results$CellType, levels = sort(unique(cell_types)))
  
  return(results)
  
})
```

```{r}
p1 <- pcr_scores_strat$Kang18_clu_con %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Selection, PCR_cn), y = PCR_cn, fill = Selection)) +
    geom_col() +
    coord_flip() +
    facet_wrap(~ CellType, scales = "free_y") + 
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      text = element_text(size = 16)
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_map) +
    labs(x = "", y = "PCR_cn", title = "Cell Types & Conditions")

ggsave("da_pcr_strat_clu_con.png", p1, path = "../../outs/kang/",
       width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 300)

p1
```
